title: WrapData
description: Off-chain wrap JSON hashed into WrapRecord.data_hash. Bytes MUST be produced with RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) before SHA-256. See docs/verify-data.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this wrap-data document schema. Distinct from the on-chain storage schema_version() query. Bump when field semantics change; verifiers MUST reject unknown versions.

period.description: Optional YYYYMM period mirrored for off-chain convenience. Not checked on-chain against WrapRecord.period.

archetype.description: Optional archetype label mirrored for off-chain convenience.

score.description: Optional numeric score used in reference examples.

level.description: Optional level / tier label used in reference examples.
